properties.displayName: Enforce custom rules on Azure Front Door WAF policies
properties.description: Enforces supplied custom rules with a PolicyEnforced name suffix and the selected action. Reconciles all managed rule settings, preserves unrelated rules, and allocates conflicting priorities from 100 through 1000.

metadata.description: An array of 1 through 10 Azure Front Door CustomRule objects, without a wrapper. Names receive PolicyEnforced unless already suffixed. All settings of matching managed rules are enforced; unrelated rules are preserved. Conflicting priorities use the lowest unused value from 100 through 1000.
ARM action applied to every supplied rule. FromRule uses each object's action instead. Only matching PolicyEnforced rules are managed.
Deploy or correct managed custom rules, audit any managed rule configuration drift, or disable evaluation.
